name: Kadampa Meditation Centre Australia
tradition: Tibetan Buddhism, Kadampa lineage (New Kadampa Tradition)
technique: Kadampa Buddhist meditation combining guided analytical and placement meditation with lamrim (stages of the path) teachings, taught through weekend and multi-day residential retreats, some held in silence.
influences: New Kadampa Tradition - International Kadampa Buddhist Union (NKT-IKBU)
teacherAccess: Guided meditations and teachings from the resident teacher, Gen Kelsang Rabten, and visiting Kadampa teachers during retreats and courses.
retreatOptions: A regular calendar of residential retreats at the centre's own temple property, including weekend meditation retreats, silent weekend retreats, and longer retreats (multi-day silent retreats and month-long counting retreats).
about: Kadampa Meditation Centre Australia (KMCA) is the national centre for Kadampa Buddhism in Australia, an hour outside Melbourne in the Dandenong Ranges at Monbulk. The centre is built around a purpose-built Buddhist Temple for World Peace and is home to a residential community of monks, nuns, and lay practitioners within the New Kadampa Tradition founded by Geshe Kelsang Gyatso Rinpoche. KMCA runs a year-round program of classes, workshops, and residential retreats - including weekend meditation retreats, silent weekend retreats, and longer retreats such as a multi-day silent retreat on the Heart Sutra and a month-long Vajrayogini counting retreat - led by resident teacher Gen Kelsang Rabten and visiting Kadampa teachers. On-site accommodation ranges from ensuite and shared rooms to dorm rooms, pre-erected tents, and camping.
schedule: Retreat days combine guided meditation sessions with Buddhist teachings; silent retreats add periods of Noble Silence between sessions, while longer retreats (e.g. the Vajrayogini counting retreat) follow an extended practice schedule over several weeks.
cost: Retreat and course fees are charged per event and cover teaching; accommodation is booked and charged separately by room type.

pricePerDay.notes: No single published nightly rate; retreat/course fees and accommodation (ensuite, shared, dorm, or camping) are booked and priced separately per event on the online shop.

foodNotes: Catering arrangements are not detailed on the public retreat pages; check individual retreat listings for meal inclusions.
workNotes: No structured work/service requirement is published for short retreat guests.
